think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and documented valid range/default. 2) Check whether any particular numeric value (e.g., -1, 0) is documented to switch the parameter into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/infinite/sentinel behavior) rather than just being a smaller/larger setting. 3) If such a sentinel exists, classify as a special knob and record the sentinel value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
